offence_note: Sexual interference, child luring, making child pornography; dangerous offender
sentence_quote: On September 24, 2014, the sentencing judge declared the appellant a dangerous offender and imposed an indeterminate sentence.
note: Dangerous offender designation and indeterminate sentence upheld despite fresh evidence.

sentence_quote: I am suspending the passing of sentence and impose a 36 month period of probation
note: Ancillary orders sought by Crown granted but not specified.

sentence_quote: We would grant leave to appeal, allow the appeal, and vary the sentence only by setting aside the order made under s. 734(1) of the Criminal Code directing the respondent to pay a fine.
note: Crown appeal; $3,000 fine set aside, conditional discharge with probation and 6-month driving prohibition stand.

offence_note: Second degree murder and two manslaughters of one victim
co_offenders: Narcisse: 7 years before credit, 3 years after credit; Johnny: 6 years before credit, 2 years less a day after credit, then 2 years probation
sentence_quote: I sentence Mr. Edwards to imprisonment for life.
systemic_quote: Considering the principles outlined in Gladue and Courtereille, I will fix that period at twelve years.
note: Johnny's probation requires residential alcohol treatment only if directed by probation officer.

offence_note: Assault causing bodily harm, threats, obstruct justice, discharging firearm with intent
sentence_quote: In the result, I find the court has jurisdiction to order a psychiatric assessment for sentencing purposes pursuant to ss. 721(4) and 723(3) of the Code
note: Ruling ordering psychiatric assessment for pre-sentence report; sentence not yet imposed.

offence_note: Possession of cocaine and heroin for trafficking
sentence_quote: The appeal is therefore allowed and a sentence of 12 months from today's date to be served conditionally on the terms and conditions outlined by counsel will be substituted for the sentence that was imposed by the sentencing judge.
note: Joint submission; six months jail replaced by 12-month conditional sentence on fresh evidence.

offence_note: Second degree murder; improper interference with human remains
sentence_quote: I would allow the sentence appeal only to the extent of an amendment to the Warrant of Committal from a credit of 699 days in predisposition custody to 753 days.
note: Four years concurrent for interference with remains; only remand credit increased on appeal.

offence_note: Historical indecent assault on three daughters
sentence_quote: The total sentence is two years less one day.
note: Six years reduced to two years less a day served in community because offender is terminally ill.

offence_note: Break and enter with intent into occupied dwelling
sentence_quote: I will fix the sentence at five years incarceration, with credit for remand time from March 1, 2012.
note: Credit length not stated; runs from March 1, 2012. Victim surcharge waived.

offence_note: Home invasion robbery, forcible confinement, aggravated assault, firearm possession, threat
sentence_quote: We would vary the sentence by making the sentence for unlawful possession of a firearm concurrent to the other sentences
note: Total reduced from nine to seven years by making firearm sentence concurrent.
